messages:
Ivy: PSA 10: the whiteboard in the north room just updated itself with 'model cards' for the office plants. did someone leave an LLM open near markers? :seedling:
DryEraseBot: [automated] Document update detected: 3 new plant model cards. Auto-saved to #random and /mnt/plant-ml.
Carmen: omg please paste one, i'm dying to see a philodendron benchmark
Ivy: ```Model: Philodendron-v1
Type: On-Persona Houseplant
Size: 52cm canopy
Input modalities: sunlight (lux), water (ml/week), talk-to-it (optional)
Latency: responds to praise within 2 minutes
Failure modes: droop when under-watered, overconfident if overexposed to memes
Suggested hyperparams: water=150, soil_aeration=0.3, window_exposure='east'
Notes: exhibits graceful leaf-drop under extreme stress; fine with Team Standups.```
Theo: leaf-drop as graceful degradation, brilliant :laughing:
Ben: can we get an A/B test between Philodendron-v1 and Succulent-XL? i'm curious about throughput under keyboard vibrations
Ivy: ```Model: Succulent-XL
Inference budget: low
Serving mode: intermittently online (hibernation cycles during 9pm-7am)
Robustness: tolerant to sparse watering, highly cache-friendly (stores water in leaves)
Quirks: attractive to fly-bots, may trigger mercy-deploy (repotting) if neglected```
Carmen: ops-bot this is relevant to oncall right? any SLOs for plant-care? :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
ops-bot: Attention: New non-human SLAs proposed. Suggested retention policy: water_daily, check-soil-weekly. Incident role: plant-victim-response-team. :rotating_light:
Ava: poll: which plant model would you allocate a 1-1 with at the all-hands?
Ava: :herb: Philodendron-v1
Ava: :cactus: Succulent-XL
Theo: voted :herb: because it gives the best conference call empathy
Ben: voted :cactus: low ops cost wins
Carmen: also requesting a sticker that says 'I tuned the office philodendron'
Ivy: action: adding sticky note to backlog 'plant ops: stickers & A/B watering experiment' and moved to sprint retro.
